mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Strategy, Portfolio Governance & Standards
Own quality strategy, standards, and delivery health across multiple products, projects, and peak traffic periods
Define org-wide QA processes, test automation frameworks, and the core quality metrics executive leadership relies on
Partner with Engineering, Product, and business leaders on release readiness, risk management, and multi-product sprint execution
Establish a high bar for engineering standards, test coverage, and code craftsmanship across functional and automated testing
2. Test Automation Architecture, Infrastructure & AI Innovation
Design, evolve, and scale modern test automation frameworks (Playwright, TypeScript, Cypress) used across the QA org
Drive AI-augmented testing as a baseline standard across teams (AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, coverage analysis, and triage)
Own CI/CD test integration, test infrastructure, reporting, and proactive flaky-test reduction to ensure fast, reliable build pipelines
Stay hands-on - write and review automation code, troubleshoot complex pipeline failures, and set technical standards by example
3. Leadership, Team Growth & Talent Bench
Lead, coach, and mentor QA Leads, Senior QAs, and Automation Engineers into autonomous leaders
Build a multiplier culture where success is measured by your team outperforming and outgrowing you
Build and scale the QA organization by maintaining an always-on recruitment pipeline ahead of business growth
Create clarity, establish autonomous team operating models, and foster high ownership with zero hand-holding culture
4. Cross-Functional Alignment & Continuous Improvement
Embed quality, automation, and continuous integration into the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle
Represent quality in company-wide planning, resource allocation, and prioritization across competing product lines
Proactively manage technical debt, test environment risks, and opportunities for testing innovation

Quality Leadership & Portfolio Strategy
7–8+ years of professional experience in QA with a proven track record managing QA teams, QA Leads, or multi-product portfolios
Deep expertise defining end-to-end quality strategies - from initial scope to final sign-off across complex digital products
Proven experience in high-growth, fast-moving environments 
Test Automation & Architecture
Deep hands-on expertise with Playwright and TypeScript (or modern equivalents like Cypress, Selenium) including building frameworks from scratch
Strong programming fundamentals, code review capabilities, and advocacy for code craftsmanship
Proven experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and managing test infrastructure
AI-Augmented Testing
Hands-on fluency applying AI tools to daily testing tasks (test case generation, triage, coverage gap analysis, flaky test diagnosis)
Ability to drive team-wide adoption of AI-assisted QA processes as a baseline capability
People Leadership & Hiring
Demonstrated track record as a "multiplier" - growing engineers into leaders and building high-performing, autonomous teams
Active experience in hiring, pipeline building, and hiring for long-term growth rather than control
High autonomy, strong ownership, and a calm, decisive leadership style under pressure
Communication
Exceptional stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, and Business functions
Fluent in written and spoken English
